name: Compal Broadband Networks, Inc.
summary: Compal Broadband Networks, Inc. develops and sells networking, home security, home entertainment, and wireless accessories in Taiwan, Belgium, Turkey, the Netherlands, the United States, Brazil, Vietnam, and China. The company offers communication products, such as smart gateways, digital set-top boxes, and wireless broadband routers; broadband access products, such as DOCSIS, FTTx/PON, whole home mesh Wi-Fi, and 5G NR; LTE/5G mobility products; and home networking products. It also provides base stations. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Zhubei, Taiwan.
